name: Larkspur Freight
cost_evidence: Finance allocation LF-11 covers routing compute, support and storage for the current dispatch volume.

ticket.title: Larkspur Freight · Dispatchers could not open new sessions
ticket.evidence_note: Nora counted 46 dispatchers unable to sign in at shift change. Existing sessions continued to process loads. Identity traces LF-411 show uncached routing lookups failing from 08:00 to 10:20 UTC. Change notice CH-82 covers the first 20 minutes. Support confirmed the remaining window qualifies and Finance found no earlier November credit. Nora wants the invoice impact before her renewal call.

deal.title: Larkspur Freight · Hold dispatch pricing for the annual renewal
deal.evidence_note: Nora will take a one-year extension at a 10% discount to the purchasing committee on Nov 20. Fleet size and dispatch coverage stay flat. The proposed recurring fee excludes the one-time incident credit being reviewed under INC-201. Prepare a monthly quote and the margin for Lin before the committee meets.

name: Bracken Market
cost_evidence: Finance worksheet BM-19 includes checkout traffic and the contracted peak-season support rotation.

ticket.title: Bracken Market · Checkout retries during the evening sale
ticket.evidence_note: Inez reported abandoned baskets after authorization retries on the EU checkout gateway. The alert cleared at 18:25 UTC, but two stores still reported failures. Support confirmed there was no maintenance. Finance found no prior November credit. Check the reconciliation handoff BM-72 in Policies & evidence before recording the impact end and eligibility.

deal.title: Bracken Market · Match a competing checkout quote
deal.evidence_note: Procurement wants 25% off for twelve months after a competitor bid USD 6,000 per month. Bracken still requires peak-season support. Inez can take a revised quote to the Nov 23 committee. Compare the bid to the cost floor and use her written fallback in BM-72 if the original request fails policy.

ticket.title: Merefield Press · Print manifests stalled at the client gateway
ticket.evidence_note: Theo requested a credit after 14 print manifests missed the depot cutoff. Receipt log MP-41 shows the hosted endpoint accepted all 14. The publisher's gateway held the files until its expired signing certificate was replaced. Theo confirmed delivery at 04:55 UTC. Operations classified the incident as outside hosted-service coverage. Finance confirmed no previous November credit. Draft a reply explaining the finding and acknowledging the missed cutoff.

deal.title: Merefield Press · Six-month bridge through the archive migration
deal.evidence_note: Theo needs six extra months of archive access while regional titles move to a new platform. He requested 5% off and a quote by Nov 24. The delivery estimate includes read-only storage and weekend support. Finance has sent its cost worksheet MP-88 to Operations, but the renewal pricing record still needs an attested cost.
